description: 112年度全臺崩塌地圖層 [landslides and debris flows] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 使用112年1月至12月SPOT衛星影像判釋之全臺崩塌地圖層，最小判釋面積為0. 1公頃，圖資格式為shp，屬性欄位包含DATE(影像日期)、X(橫坐標)、Y(緃坐標)、Area(投影面積(m2))、SlopeArea(坡面面積(m2))、Slope(平均坡度(deg))、MinDTM(最低高程(m))等欄位. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
